_comment: Project configuration for the orchestrate plugin, which lives in this repository at plugins/orchestrate; its README documents every key. tests/test_workflow_tables.py checks this file with the plugin's scripts/check_config.py.
_comment_named_checks: The CI checks the Orchestrator drives to green: every job of test.yml and codeql.yml, less the merge gate. A change that adds or removes one of those jobs updates this list in the same change.
_comment_ignored: Administrative merge holds (not failure) is the merge gate of administrative-merge-holds.yml: it is red for the whole of every cycle by design, so it is left off named_checks and out of the Monitor's verdict (the parentheses are escaped because the value is a regex).
